_doc: sediment in the settling basins (lane s, 24 Nov 2026): the rating and the yield are sourced (S), every other entry is an assumption (A); engine site/js/engine/sediment.js

rating_a: sediment rating Qs = a Qw^b (Qs t/day, Qw m3/s), 1986-87 survey
yield_t_yr: at Martapura, 1988-98 mean (1,162 t/km2/yr); mostly sand bed load in the description, about 15 % bed load in the estimate
rating_fit_yield: the sourced rating on the mean year's monthly flows (hydro.monthly_mean_m3s) carries 14.2 Mt/yr, 2.8 times the sourced yield; with this on, the coefficient is scaled so the mean year carries 5.02 Mt/yr (a = 0.0187, computed in engine/sediment.js ratingA), keeping the sourced exponent
conc_max_mgL: the rating is extrapolated beyond its survey flows: the river concentration is held at this value (reached near 1,000 m3/s with the fitted rating)
intake_factor: concentration of the water the intake draws / the river's mean concentration: the scouring sluices and the intake sill keep the bed load (about 15 %) and most sand near the bed out
intake_sand_share: share of sand (coarser than about 0.06 mm) in the load the intake draws; the rest is silt and clay
trap_sand: share of that sand a settling basin keeps at its design flow of 16 m3/s
trap_fine: share of the silt and clay a settling basin keeps
trap_full_from: a basin keeps less as it fills: full trapping up to this share of its storage, falling to nothing at full
dry_density_t_m3: dry bulk density of a fresh sand and silt deposit
storage_depth_m: mean depth of the storage for deposit below the flowing water, about a quarter of the 2.9-4.3 m section: storage per basin = 45 x 140 x 1.0 = 6,300 m3
flush_at: automatic rule: the fullest basin is flushed when its storage is this full, one basin at a time, so the canal keeps running from the other four; no flushing schedule was found (2001 O&M records)
flush_hours: time a flush takes to clear the deposit down to flush_left
flush_left: share of the deposit left in the basin when a flush ends
flush_q_m3s: flushing flow through the basin's 10 flushing gates (3.0 x 0.8 m) and Saluran Bilas back to the river: taken as the basin's design flow; it runs only on water the river can spare beyond the intake
start_fill: fill of each basin (west first) at the start of a run: a scheme that flushes in turn has its basins at different fills
